name: Solace-class armoured medevac
role: Light 4x4 armoured ambulance and utility runabout: follows the fireteam right up to the line, recovers a downed Vigilant (exosuit and all) into a protected litter pod, and runs them back to the aid post. The rear pod swaps for recon and utility fits.
capacity: 2 armoured litters (suited casualties) + 1 medic, or 4 seated Vigilants in the utility pod

weapons.main: cab-roof light repeater on a ring mount
weapons.secondary: smoke dischargers; no offensive fit under the medevac marking

weapons.main: open bed with telescopic sensor mast + twin Spindle anti-armour missiles
cargo/ammo pod with crane arm; pintle heavy repeater

blockout_note: Overlapping primitive shells at 1:56 mm (visual blockout, not a unioned print mesh).
